item.description: GUWAHATI: In a significant development in the high-profile Meghalaya honeymoon murder case, police have dropped two individuals from a fresh chargesheet, after they concluded there was insufficient evidence linking them to the alleged destruction of crucial evidence, as said on Tuesday, February 3. item.title: Fire Guts Scrap Shop in Guwahati’s Gopinath Nagar, No Casualties Reported
item.description: GUWAHATI: A massive fire broke out at a scrap shop in Guwahati’s Gopinath Nagar area at around 9:30 pm on Tuesday, February 3, reducing the establishment to ashes. Fortunately, no casualties were reported in the incident.
